body:
SULAIR Kiosk wrote:

>Does anybody think that the FBI monitors this newsgroup?
>Any evidence of posters being questioned or tapped by them?

I don't think you need to worry about expressing your opinion here, any more
than elsewhere on the internet.

Here are a few quotes:

Gerry Spence - "From Freedom to Slavery"

"Freedom in America [and elsewhere - my comment] works best for those who can
afford it...It is not as much a liberated state of being as it is an item on
the shelf, that along with the purchaser, may be purchased. It is not as much a
right as a component of commerce...
...on the other hand...
...If I make minimal efforts at compliance with the rules that preserve the
power structure, I will likely be left alone, even if I criticize the power
structure."  - from the introductory chapter entitled 'To Begin With'.

Ted Kaczynski - "Industrial Society and its Future"

"The degree of personal freedom that exists in a society is determined more by
the economic and technological structure of the society than by its laws or
forms of government." Paragraph 95.
and
"Modern society is in certain respects extremely permissive. In matters that
are irrelevant to the functioning of the system we can generally do what we
please." Paragraph 72.

Of course, I'm pretty sure the FBI is responsible for me not getting certain
e-mail attachments from my friends (conspirators???), such as the Bill Gates
pie in the face game!!! Fortunately, the ancient sneakernet system still works
:-}
